## What did you ask it?

The exact command.

## What did it say?

Paste the outcome block, including the `coverage:` line.

## How do you know the thing exists?

The URL, record, or alternate query that finds it.

## What were you doing when this happened?

The research task. Field context is what makes these diagnosable — most of the
false-negative bugs found so far only appear when someone reaches for the
identifier they happen to have rather than the one the API wants.
